blocks.text: Numbers decline. In the nominative and accusative (for things) they govern the noun as you know; in **every other case**, the number and noun simply both go into that case:

**Пять** to **два́дцать** and **три́дцать** decline like **тетра́дь**: пяти́, пятью́. With **два, три, четыре**, an adjective goes in the **genitive plural**: **два но́вых** стола́; with feminine nouns usually nominative plural: **две но́вые** кни́ги.
Put the noun **before** the number to make it approximate: **лет пять** — *about five years*, **часа́ через два** — *in about two hours*.

**Дво́е, тро́е, че́тверо** (+ genitive plural) count people and pairs: **у них дво́е дете́й**; **нас бы́ло тро́е**. **Полтора́** (m./n.) / **полторы́** (f.) — *one and a half* + genitive singular: полтора́ часа́, полторы́ неде́ли.

exercises.why: Noun before the number makes it approximate: **часа два**.
